[[File:Proboscidean.png|thumb|External and internal structure of an eopie's trunk]]
'''Proboscidean''' (also spelled '''proboscidian''') was a broad term describing [[Species/Legends|species]] that either had a long trunk or fed through a [[Proboscis/Legends|proboscis]], such as the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] were proboscideans with hinged skulls supporting flexible, elongated snouts.<ref name="WoSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Some proboscidians were also [[pachydermoid]]s.<ref name="NEGAS" />
